note: Not a protocol failure. The coordinator refused a malformed compliance proof correctly. Everything upstream of it ran on real contracts and real cross-chain messages.

stages.note: prepareAsset succeeded here, on the same call that reverted in the previous run. Consistent with the stale-read hypothesis; not by itself proof of it. ASM open.

stages.stage: coordinator records the local cash leg

stages.note: Real Base Sepolia economic finality, not the 2.6s instant path. Nothing was downgraded to make this faster.

stages.stage: coordinator consumes the ASSET_PREPARED VAA (Monad Testnet)
proves: a producer-originated message crossed Base to Monad and was accepted by the real consumer
peer emitter and emitter chain verified against the locked peer
deployment id, protocol version and destination chain verified
settlement finality enforced: an instant VAA would have been refused

stages.cause: The runner built the attestation with viem signTypedData against an undefined domain and kept a catch-based fallback that would have signed the correct digest. The first path did not throw, it succeeded incorrectly, so the fallback never ran and the signature covered a domain the contract does not use. The coordinator recovered an unauthorised address and refused.
stages.protocolBehaviour: correct — a malformed proof was rejected rather than accepted

fix: proofFor now derives the EIP-712 digest explicitly from the verifying contract's own attestationDomainSeparator, signs the raw hash, and recovers it locally before returning. A wrong signer fails in the second rather than twenty-five minutes into a live settlement. No fallback and no catch.
stillOpen: prepareAsset stale-read hypothesis needs the field-by-field capture and dual-provider check
issueCommit onward is unproven: COMMIT, both releases, SETTLED_FINAL, replay rejection, post-COMMIT refund rejection, verifier agreement
